F5 MUST Instant feedback 
on lessons and 
questions 
Immediate feedback post-question 
displaying whether the student was 
correct, while also showing the answer to 
the question; aligns with insights from 
(Panadero, et al., 2017; Barana, et al., 
2019). 
Outcome: Instant clarification, 
addressment of misconceptions and 
reinforcement of correct answers. 
F6 SHOULD Gem based reward 
system 
The student should be rewarded in the 
form of gems for accomplishments such 
as lesson performance.
